final: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT t.rowid AS team_row, t.team_id, AVG(1.0 * mh.w / NULLIF(mh.g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(mh.rowid) AS record_count FROM team AS t LEFT JOIN manager_half AS mh ON mh.year = t.year AND mh.team_id = t.team_id AND mh.league_id = t.league_id GROUP BY t.rowid), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT tr.team_id, tr.avg_win_rate, tr.record_count, tr.avg_win_rate - o.mean_win_rate AS difference FROM team_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tr.avg_win_rate IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
